excludes: advisory or ignored diagnostic aggregate counts
cache_fingerprint_contract.reason: generic specialization order can change formatted diagnostic text and advisory counts without changing source location, blocker, or recovered connectivity facts

cold_frontend_worker_model.default_admission: one active cold build per server until Phase 1 adds memory-aware single-flight/resource admission
cold_frontend_worker_model.reason: The 2s timeout test reaped the worker without residue, native crash containment is required, and OpenTitan peaks near 2.14 GiB RSS per worker.

dependency_model.reason: pyslang is a native, platform-specific wheel and source connectivity is additive to TraceWeave's existing log/wave functionality
dependency_model.unsupported_platform_policy: structured optional-dependency blocker; no global install, silent source build, or bundled fallback
dependency_model.validated_platform: CPython 3.11 Linux x86_64 manylinux wheel only

assessment.evidence_scope: Phase 0B frontend feasibility only: parsing, elaborated hierarchy, source locations, diagnostics, and frontend-exposed object counts; no Source Graph edges or production accuracy claim
known_limitations: The full OpenTitan chip workload has 65 stable effective Slang errors: unresolved bind/hierarchical paths, procedural-force/runtime assertion constructs, Cadence UVM extension hooks, and UVM sequence type conversions. The result remains blocked even though all annotated hierarchy/file-line oracles match.

Native DPI implementations and simulator runtime system tasks are outside HDL connectivity; encrypted payloads or missing simulator-provided source libraries are explicit blockers, never silent fallback.
Aggregate frontend visitor counts can vary with native specialization traversal and are reported benchmark facts, not cache/connectivity identity.
phase_1_acceptance_items: Implement and validate Connectivity IR edge semantics for named/positional ports, slice/concat bit mapping, continuous/procedural drivers, and sequential dependencies.
Measure persistent-worker warm behavior, cache artifact size, storage-cold build, cancellation during projection, and single-flight only after the Phase 1 worker/cache design exists.
Keep explicit coverage/inconclusive receipts for unsupported bind, force, protected-source, DPI, and simulator-extension regions; do not call partial OpenTitan elaboration production-accurate.

repository_evidence_context.scope: Explicit repository-level Phase 0B synthesis across the original three Slang workloads, cc29 Xcelium/FSDB evidence, the Surelog comparison, and this OpenTitan scale workload.

slang_primary_frontend.scope: Primary for the prototype and synthesizable/core hierarchy; full OpenTitan UVM, bind, procedural-force, and simulator-extension semantics remain incomplete.

surelog_uhdm_comparison.reason: Slang's evidenced gaps triggered comparison, but pinned sc-surelog 1.84.1 segfaulted before producing a recovered top or UHDM objects on the smaller cc29 Xcelium workload; the official 1.86 source fetch was network-blocked and is availability evidence only. No automatic Surelog/UHDM fallback is justified.

dependency.isolation: fresh child processes using a /tmp virtual environment

platform_policy.unsupported_platform_policy: report the optional frontend dependency as unavailable; do not infer frontend incompatibility, install globally, source-build, or bundle an unvalidated artifact

orchestrator_frontend_availability.interpretation: package presence only; absence is not frontend incompatibility

methodology.execution: one workload per fresh child interpreter; the parent does not import pyslang
methodology.oracles: tracked hand annotation is mandatory; FSDB/KDB/NPI evidence is development-only supplemental input
methodology.preprocess_parse: preprocess is an independent runPreprocessor probe; parseAllSources necessarily preprocesses again
methodology.production_claim: feasibility data only; no Source Graph backend or routing is implemented
methodology.rss: start/end are VmRSS and peak is process-lifetime VmHWM; each cold sample exits after one workload

excluded_inputs.native_dpi_implementations: C/C++/object/shared-library inputs are recorded but not parsed
excluded_inputs.protected_source: legacy envelopes are enabled; encrypted payloads that the frontend cannot decode must remain an explicit blocker, never a fallback
excluded_inputs.runtime_system_tasks: unknown simulator system-task diagnostics are suppressed only; HDL arguments and surrounding processes remain parsed

diagnostic_policy.reason: Xcelium UVM and testbench sources call vendor atomics, stack helpers, and FSDB dump tasks that are external to HDL connectivity
diagnostic_policy.risk: DPI/system-call behavior is excluded; any connectivity created only by those calls remains unsupported
